names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 13812, «Аполлинария (Тупицына), мц.», with the rank word left off.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints directly after her name, which is the last of the eleven: «… мц. Аполлинарии (1937)».

feast.note: Her name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 30 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. … мц. Аполлинарии (1937).», and the same site's index of names heads her page «Аполлинария (Тупицына), мц.»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's own 13 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/13 was not read for her (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for civil 13 October 2026 was not read (2026-10-04).
